types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateTradingWithdrawRequest
types.doc:
CreateTradingWithdrawRequest creates or returns one durable backend-authorized
 Trading withdraw intent from typed protobuf fields and an API-key signature.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Client-signed withdraw details.

fields.name: payload_signature
fields.doc: User/API signature over deterministic TradingWithdrawIntentPayload bytes.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateTradingWithdrawResponse
types.doc:
CreateTradingWithdrawResponse returns the accepted durable intent identifier
 for the withdraw lifecycle.

fields.name: intent_id
fields.doc:
Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle.
 Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateWalletTradingWithdrawRequest
types.doc:
CreateWalletTradingWithdrawRequest creates or returns one durable Trading
 withdraw intent from typed frontend fields plus a wallet EIP-712 signature.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Client-signed withdraw details.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Optional public subaccount id. Omit to withdraw from the JWT root account.

fields.name: signer_wallet
fields.doc: Wallet address that produced payload_signature.

fields.name: payload_signature
fields.doc: Wallet EIP-712 signature over the typed withdraw payload.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.CreateWalletTradingWithdrawResponse
types.doc:
CreateWalletTradingWithdrawResponse returns the accepted durable intent
 identifier for a wallet-authorized withdraw lifecycle.

fields.name: intent_id
fields.doc:
Stable server-owned intent identifier for the accepted withdraw lifecycle.
 Clients use this id to follow later progress for the same withdraw flow.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.TradingWithdrawAction
types.doc: TradingWithdrawAction identifies where funds should move from Trading.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.TradingWithdrawIntentPayload
types.doc:
TradingWithdrawIntentPayload is the client-signed typed withdraw request.
 Account scope and backend intent ids are derived server-side.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Destination for funds leaving Trading.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset identifier from Polyester asset metadata. amount_e18 is
 denominated in this asset at canonical 18-decimal scale.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: External network id for TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN. Omit for TO_FUNDING.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Withdraw amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.
 For example, 0.5 is encoded as 500000000000000000.

fields.name: deadline_ts_sec
fields.doc:
Unix timestamp in seconds after which this signed user authorization is no
 longer accepted by the API. This is separate from the server-owned
 execution deadline used later for on-chain submission.

fields.name: nonce
fields.doc:
Client-generated unsigned 128-bit nonce bound to the signed request. This
 is an identifier, not a decimal amount.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Destination address. For TO_EXTERNAL_CHAIN this is an address on
 destination_chain_id and is validated according to that network. For
 TO_FUNDING, omit it to move funds to the selected account's Funding account
 or provide another Polyester funding address for a Trading-to-Funding
 transfer.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Client-chosen idempotency key. Reusing the same key with the same payload
 returns the existing withdraw; reusing it with different payload fails.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ValidateWithdrawDestinationRequest
types.doc:
ValidateWithdrawDestinationRequest checks one external-chain
 destination for an authenticated caller without creating a withdraw.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: External destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Destination address to validate for destination_chain_id.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.ValidateWithdrawDestinationResponse
types.doc:
ValidateWithdrawDestinationResponse returns a user-safe validation
 result without exposing internal denylist details.

fields.name: valid
fields.doc: Whether the destination may be used for a withdraw.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Public validation outcome code.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: User-safe explanation of the validation outcome.

fields.name: canonical_destination_address
fields.doc: Canonical destination address when valid. Empty when valid is false.

types.name: chain.withdraw.v1.WithdrawDestinationValidationCode
types.doc:
WithdrawDestinationValidationCode identifies the public outcome of an
 external-chain destination validation.

values.name: VALID
values.doc: The destination is valid and may be used for a withdraw.

values.name: INVALID_ADDRESS
values.doc: The address is not valid for the selected destination chain.

values.name: UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN
values.doc: The selected destination chain is not supported for withdraws.

values.name: POLYESTER_SMART_ACCOUNT
values.doc:
The destination is a Polyester smart account and cannot be used for an
 external-chain withdraw.

values.name: TOKEN_CONTRACT
values.doc: The destination is a token contract and cannot receive withdrawals.

values.name: DENYLISTED_ADDRESS
values.doc: The destination is blocked by Polyester's user-safety denylist.
